description: This source file defines a class `LassoGuardrail` which integrates Lasso Security API into the LiteLLM ecosystem for content moderation, policy enforcement, and violation handling. It includes methods for pre-call, post-call, and during-call hooks, API communication, violation processing, masking, and conversation ID management.
